notes.title: Progress Update 08
notes.notes: [h3][b]September 25, 2025 Progress Update[/b][/h3][p]These busy days seem to stretch endlessly into the horizon... The work I'm running in parallel continues to move forward: Grenearl's VA has completed 80% of the retake, and I still have 500 lines on my end that I haven't had time to review yet; Two days ago, Diana James finished proofreading episodes E01-E24, and I'm quite curious about her thoughts on Evgeniya's storyline haha, but before that, I still need to provide her with the completed E3-E5 scripts this week;[/p][p]Meanwhile, the production of Elegy of St. Godhrkar is also progressing steadily: Since some chapters of J2 need additional content to be written, this work has been handed over to 长高, so I've started working on S3's coding instead. I expect to finish it this week, so that can begin working on S4's storyline during the National Day holiday! I'm finally reached the storyline that I has been eagerly anticipating - when the time comes, I'll definitely have to treat everyone to a big feast![/p][h3][b]~-Andinomie- Worldbuilding Knowledge Corner~[/b][/h3][p]Q: After Letzeriel regains his Wsarl power, can he communicate with Godhrkar? Can he make it manifest? It feels like Letzeriel is the type that would treats Godhrkar like a wishing well, asking it to give him five hundred Thil and such. Also, Poreiy said that what Godhrkar granted to "Perrey" was never resurrection, so what was it? Can he ask Godhrkar to power him up? Like Letzeriel in 11th, or is the power weaker? If Poreiy could do that, it feels like he could fight much faster.[/p][p]A: Letzeriel has tried calling out to Godhrkar, but unfortunately it seems the other party doesn't intend to pay him any attention (..................)[/p][p]Therefore, not only can he not make Godhrkar manifest, he also can't communicate with them. All Letzeriel has received are Godhrkar's promises from the commandments.[/p][p]For this generation's Wsarl, what Godhrkar granted is an ability to control oneself that surpasses ordinary people. For example, Letzeriel's trick skills come from his ability to precisely sense the weight differences of cards and chips through touch. If he wanted to, he could also freely control his sleep and wake times, and if necessary, he could even control the growth of body parts like hair. The recovery ability that Poreiy "borrowed" actually stems from this.[/p][p]Additionally, this kind of borrowing is equivalent to Godhrkar turning a blind eye, and Poreiy cannot demand more from Godhrkar - his own conditions aren't compatible enough either.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565067/72e1235e8a7bd5a68f476483cba63f9990868f25.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Progress Update 07
notes.notes: [h3][b]Progress Update: September 11, 2025[/b][/h3][p]Since August, I have been working on multiple fronts simultaneously. [/p][p]I've been in touch with Grenearl's voice actor, Elizaveta, to record the audio for the second time. She is highly professional and easy to communicate with. Initially, both of us were concerned about whether the re-recording would meet expectations, so I provided her with a machine-translated full script of Gren's lines along with recent gameplay videos for reference. Fortunately, the new recordings have turned out much better! The re-recording process is now in full swing. A huge thank you to Elizaveta for her hard work and dedication![/p][p]On the translation and proofreading front, Diana has completed proofreading the character profiles. After discussion, we decided to start with Evgeniya's route. I've provided her with the translated texts for E01 to E24, and the proofreading for these chapters is expected to be completed by the end of September.[/p][p]The publishing rights for Knell of St. Godhrkar have been successfully transferred. Both the Taptap and Steam publishing rights have been returned to me, which will make future updates much more convenient. (Will there actually be updates? Maybe!)[/p][p]Additionally, over the past two weeks, I've finished the coding for J1's scenes. This week, I'll begin working on J2's scenes. The mysterious mini-game I've been planning to add is finally coded and playable! With this progress, I've also fixed long-standing bugs in the main story's finale route, and internal testing is about to begin![/p][p][/p][h3][b]~ Antinomy Worldview Knowledge Corner ~[/b][/h3][p]Q: Hi, I noticed that some default options seem to be randomized. Why is that? During my playthrough, I found that the default choices in G11 varied even when I made the same prior decisions. Could you explain this?[/p][p]A: Ah, you caught that! Generally, if a default option appears randomized, it means the character has no strong preference between the choices—either both options are equally unimportant or both are deeply desired. In G11, whether it's Priscilla or Rihert, both are irreplaceable best friends to Grenearl. When faced with a dilemma, he genuinely wants to help both of them. He really treasures his friends a lot![/p][p](P.S. Every week, we select interesting questions from our readers to answer. If you have any questions about the St. Godhrkar series, feel free to ask. Your question might be featured next time! ✨)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565067/164fbfea4a6f716dc5657204077caf17db05c8e3.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Chronicle 05 | Pharmaceutical Giant Under Fire for Falsified Drug Trial Data
notes.notes: [p]October 15, 1544, Ili City, Skia Province[/p][p]Hormine Pharmaceuticals is facing an investigation after whistleblowers alleged the company fabricated clinical trial data for an emergency treatment released during a deadly seafood poisoning outbreak, raising serious questions about drug safety oversight.[/p][p]The drug hit the market in late 1544 as Ili City grappled with a public health crisis that left hundreds hospitalized and dozens dead from contaminated seafood. Victims suffered severe vomiting, disorientation, and in the worst cases, organ failure.[/p][p]Federal investigators now say clinical trials for the emergency treatment—which contains croton seeds, lactulose, and glycerol—were based on falsified data. Medical experts warn that extended use of the medication can trigger dangerous electrolyte imbalances, liver damage, and melanosis coli, a darkening of the colon typically seen with chronic laxative abuse.[/p][p]The revelations have sent shockwaves through the medical community and spooked investors. Hormine's stock has plummeted 40% since the allegations surfaced, with the sell-off rippling across pharmaceutical sectors throughout Skia Province.[/p][p] The scandal has reignited calls for stricter oversight of emergency drug approvals and highlighted gaps in the current regulatory framework.[/p][p][/p][p]"Mr.Popov, word from downtown—Hormine's markets are in free fall, and the panic is spreading north from Ili City."[/p][p]"Oh? Quite the spectacle. How are we positioned?"[/p][p]"Rest easy, Boss. We shorted their securities during the first trading suspension and doubled our position then substantially increased our exposure during that final attempt at recovery before they got delisted. I've also had a word with our contacts at Falcon Press. They're running additional exposés to keep the pressure on."[/p][p]"Haha! I knew I could count on you, Leon. But there's... one more delicate matter."[/p][p]"What troubles you, Boss?"[/p][p]"That particular medicine they made... is it still available through our usual channels?"[/p][p]"……Boss?"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565067/1768a6ddc1e6563e18d3278f22d35e4064213ced.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Progress Update 06 |Elegy's Heroine? Unlocking the Secrets of Evgenia's Route!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Progress Update: August 28, 2025[/b][/h3][p]August has been a productive month! I’ve been working overtime lately and have made significant progress: Evgenia’s voice acting has been fully implemented. But when I moved on to Grenearl, I noticed some fairly significant issues with the voice recordings… I actually picked up on them during the first recording session, but I was a bit hesitant to request too many revisions at the time (ahhh!). I thought most of it would be usable, but it turns out… it really isn’t. We’re planning to re-record after the voice actor returns from vacation in September. This time, I hope they can refer more closely to the tone and delivery references I provided ORZ.[/p][p]Our editor, Diana, has been as efficient as ever! She already completed the proofreading for locations and concepts by mid-August. Now, I’ve sent her the character profiles for proofreading. Her efficiency is almost too much, that I have to keep up and speed up the translation progress![/p][p]Also, since the publishing contract for "Knell of St. Godhrkar" has expired, the process is almost complete! While reviewing the code for the previous game, I was not only stunned by the sheer complexity but also discovered many untranslated sections in the English version.... I has decided to take some (very limited) time to optimize the code for the Knell. We’re hoping to release a major update soon (though it’ll probably break previous save files…!).[/p][p]Additionally, last week, we completed all the scenes for the first two days of the P route. One particular scene had 8 different variations due to overlapping choices! it was an intense and exhilarating mix of possibilities![/p][p][/p][h3][b]~ Antinomie World Knowledge Corner ~[/b][/h3][p]Q: Hi Birctreel! I recently finished playing the demo of Elegy and felt that this installment is another huge leap forward compared to the Knell. It feels like a major production: the writing, music, and art all show incredible dedication. The storylines for the 3 characters are also very engaging. Personally, I love Evgenia’s route the most; the power struggles among the elites reveal the darkness of human nature driven by benefit in just the right way. However, after finishing E42, I couldn’t shake a faint sense of unease. I really want to know, will Evgenia ultimately reach a bright ending, free from schemes and disguises? She will, right? She definitely will, right? TAT (Please don’t let it be like Shervlett’s route in the Knell… sob sob)[/p][p]A: Wow, thank you so much for your kind words!! I’m really glad you enjoyed Evgenia’s story![/p][p]Evgenia’s route may seem like an otome game (…), but it’s actually the most perilous of the 3 routes. Combined with the character’s own flaws, the early parts may feel a bit frustrating. But don’t worry! Her arrogance stems from courage and decisiveness—and these very traits will guide her toward a (maybe hilariously) happy ending![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565067/6c2a04197fc2d1bd31c0ca5ac0193cbeecc09405.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]
